2026-10-19.title: Tap the winner, and total XP
items: New Game: when a villain wins, tap their mover; the game stops with the winner marked, ready to save.
Every player page shows the player's total XP, the same as on the Leaderboard.

2026-10-12.title: Charts by period and number of players
items: Charts: the Leaderboard's filters on every chart, switches between views, averages and medians.
Matchups: who beats whom, villain against villain or box against box.
Solo: a clear warning on your last round, and the Phantom's die keeps its roll.

2026-10-05.title: Solo, XP, guides and a smoother New Game
items: Solo, an unofficial variant for one player against a Phantom player, with its own rankings; and XP, earned from claimed games and achievements.
All time, Year and Month on the Leaderboard, the Game Log and player pages; a guide for every villain; Villain Movers; and this page.
New Game keeps your game in progress and your draw pool; whoever recorded a game can fix or delete it; text size, Install and keyboard shortcuts.

2026-09-28.title: DiVilytics in Italian, Tutorial and F.A.Q.
items: DiVilytics in Italian, with cards, objectives and guides as printed in the Italian edition.
A Tutorial, the F.A.Q. with the official rules summarized, and every villain's decks card by card.

2026-08-03.title: Introduction to Evil and Darkness Brewing
items: Introduction to Evil's reworked villains with stats of their own, and Darkness Brewing among your boxes.
Download all your games as a CSV from your Account.

2026-07-20.title: Three new villains
items: Ernesto de la Cruz, Prince Hans and the Sanderson Sisters.

2026-06-22.title: Charts and the Players page
items: Charts: a dozen ways to explore every recorded game.
Players: search for any player, or share your profile with a QR code.

2026-06-15.title: New Account page, rivalries and more achievements
items: A new Account page, villain filters in New Game and the Game Log, and many new achievements.
Villain pages show their rivalries, and player pages who they play with most.

2026-06-01.title: Claim your villain, and build your avatar
items: Scanning a game's QR code opens its page: claim your villain, or fix the game's details.
Build your own avatar, and places you've used are suggested as you type a location.

2026-05-11.title: My boxes, achievements and Google
items: Mark the boxes you own, and earn bronze, silver and gold achievements for every villain.
Sign in with Google as well as Discord, and choose your player icon.

2026-05-04.title: A new name, New Game and the Game Log
items: DVS becomes DiVilytics, and villain pages show their rules clarifications.
Recording a game gets its own page, New Game, with the random draw, and the game history becomes the Game Log.

2026-04-20.title: DVS goes online
items: Record your games with a timer, and share a QR code so every player can claim their villain.
Game history, leaderboards, and a page for every villain and every player.
